raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions stores both unconverted. v2 rows with UTC hours 00:00-06:00 therefore land on the wrong local date, which explains the off-hours timestamps and the shifted 2026-01-19 volume. Converting v2 timestamps to America/Chicago before deriving txn_date should restore a consistent local-time convention.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH base AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN (CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM base;"}}
